BILL NUMBER:  S5500

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend chapter 412 of the laws of 2008 amending the
environmental conservation law relating to allowing the use of rifles
for hunting in the county of Madison, in relation to the effectiveness
of such provisions; and to repeal section 2 of such chapter relating
thereto


 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL :
This bill would extend the use of rifles for deer hunting in Madison
County until October 1, 2011.

 JUSTIFICATION :
In 2008, the Assembly and Senate passed legislation (chapter 412 of
the Laws of 2008) that provided for the use of rifles for deer hunting
at the request of the Conservation Clubs of Madison County. This
included a sunset of August 1, 2009. This bill would extend until
October 1, 2011 the ability of hunters to utilize a rifle for hunting
in Madison County. It is important to note that the use of rifles in
Madison County has been endorsed by the County Board of Supervisors.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
New bill, however, it extends the provisions of chapter 412 of the
laws of 2008.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately.

included a sunset of August 1, 2009. This bill would make the
provisions permanent the ability of hunters to utilize a rifle for
hunting in Madison County. It is important to note that the use of
rifles in Madison County has been endorsed by the County Board of
Supervisors.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
New bill, however, it makes permanent the provisions of chapter 412 of
the laws of 2008.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately.
